<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>FlockBuddy</id>
    <version>4.0.0</version>
    <title>FlockBuddy</title>
    <authors>dmanning23</authors>
    <owners>dmanning23</owners>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>false</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <licenseUrl>https://github.com/dmanning23/FlockBuddy/blob/master/LICENSE.txt</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/dmanning23/FlockBuddy</projectUrl>
    <description>A flocking AI for MonoGame projects</description>
    <tags>pcl, windows phone, winphone, android, ios, universal, monogame</tags>
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="MonoAndroid1.0">
        <dependency id="MonoGame.Framework.Android" version="3.7.0" />

        <dependency id="CollisionBuddy" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="GameTimer" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="MatrixExtensions" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="PrimitiveBuddy" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="RandomExtensions.dmanning23" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="RectangleF" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="Vector2Extensions" version="4.0.0" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="Xamarin.iOS1.0">
        <dependency id="MonoGame.Framework.iOS" version="3.7.0" />
        <dependency id="CellSpacePartition" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="CollisionBuddy" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="GameTimer" version="4.0.0" />

      <group targetFramework=".NETFramework4.5.2">
        <dependency id="MonoGame.Framework.WindowsDX" version="3.7.0" />
        <dependency id="CellSpacePartition" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="CollisionBuddy" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="GameTimer" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="MatrixExtensions" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="PrimitiveBuddy" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="RandomExtensions.dmanning23" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="RectangleF" version="4.0.0" />
        <dependency id="Vector2Extensions" version="4.0.0" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
